posts.title: The bird nobody was watching
posts.description: I joined Birding Bob's group in Central Park on Saturday morning. The Ramble was misty and cold. Everyone had their binoculars up, looking for warblers and rarer birds. I don't know much about birds. There was this little one walking along with us — hopping on the trail, pecking at the dirt, flying a few feet ahead and waiting. It did this for a good twenty minutes! posts.title: A cafe in Vadodara
posts.description: I came to my favorite cafe in Vadodara. I used to come here to work when I was here in 2023 - cold brew, corner seat, headphones on, lost in my laptop. I opened my laptop today and it felt good to have the wifi connect automatically. In the sea of changes, it feels reassuring to have some things not change.
